chinese: 嘿，我还以为你不喜欢数学呢！
english: Hey, I thought you didn’t like maths!

chinese: 我现在喜欢了。我去年对它不感兴趣。
english: I do now. I wasn’t interested in it last year.

chinese: 你好。你是埃拉的朋友吗？
我明天不能去参加学校的旅行了。
english: I can’t go on the school trip tomorrow.

chinese: 哦，你现在应该告诉我们的老师这件事。
english: Oh, you should tell our teacher about that now.
